$comment: Classification of every environment name the upstream compose uses: the 48 keys it passes to containers plus
the 6 it interpolates only in deployment positions (APP_BIND, APP_PORT, APP_DATA_DIR, APP_LOGS_DIR,
CHROMADB_BIND, NTFY_BIND). 54 names: 18 exposed, 26 fixed, 10 dropped. build_catalog.py rule C4 fails the
build when a compose environment key is missing from all three buckets, so an upstream addition is a red build
rather than a silently ignored setting. 'exposed' entries become manifest variables[] and are referenced as
${NAME}; 'fixed' values are baked into services[].environment verbatim; 'dropped' names are omitted entirely.

exposed.name: ODYSSEUS_ADMIN_USER
exposed.label: Admin user name
exposed.description: The user name of the administrator account Odysseus creates on first start.

exposed.name: ODYSSEUS_ADMIN_PASSWORD
exposed.label: Admin password
exposed.description: The administrator password. Required: without it Odysseus generates one and prints it to the container log.

exposed.name: LLM_HOST
exposed.label: Local model host
exposed.description: Host name Odysseus uses to reach a model server running on this computer. Leave the default to reach the Docker host.

exposed.name: OLLAMA_BASE_URL
exposed.label: Ollama base URL
exposed.description: Base URL of an Ollama-compatible server, when one should be used instead of the default local model host.

exposed.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
exposed.label: OpenAI API key
exposed.description: API key for OpenAI-hosted models. Leave empty to use local models only.

exposed.name: LLM_HOSTS
exposed.label: Additional model hosts
exposed.description: Comma-separated list of further model hosts Odysseus may route to.

exposed.name: RESEARCH_LLM_ENDPOINT
exposed.label: Research model endpoint
exposed.description: Endpoint of the model used for the research workflow, when it differs from the default one.

exposed.name: EMBEDDING_URL
exposed.label: Embedding server URL
exposed.description: URL of an external embedding server. Leave empty to embed in-process.

exposed.name: EMBEDDING_MODEL
exposed.label: Embedding model
exposed.description: Name of the model the external embedding server should use.

exposed.name: GOOGLE_PSE_CX
exposed.label: Google Programmable Search engine id
exposed.description: Search engine id (cx) of a Google Programmable Search Engine used for web search.

exposed.name: HF_TOKEN
exposed.label: Hugging Face token
exposed.description: Access token used to download gated Hugging Face models.

exposed.name: HUGGING_FACE_HUB_TOKEN
exposed.label: Hugging Face Hub token
exposed.description: Token read by the Hugging Face Hub client libraries inside the container.

exposed.name: EMBEDDING_API_KEY
exposed.label: Embedding server API key
exposed.description: API key for the external embedding server, when it requires one.

exposed.name: DATA_BRAVE_API_KEY
exposed.label: Brave Search API key
exposed.description: API key for the Brave Search data provider.

exposed.name: GOOGLE_API_KEY
exposed.label: Google API key
exposed.description: API key paired with the Google Programmable Search engine id.

exposed.name: TAVILY_API_KEY
exposed.label: Tavily API key
exposed.description: API key for the Tavily search provider.

exposed.name: SERPER_API_KEY
exposed.label: Serper API key
exposed.description: API key for the Serper search provider.

exposed.name: SEARXNG_SECRET
exposed.label: SearXNG secret key
exposed.description: Secret key for the bundled SearXNG instance. Leave empty and the container generates one on first start.

dropped.name: APP_BIND
dropped.reason: XE owns port publishing: every port is bound to 127.0.0.1 by the engine.

dropped.name: APP_PORT
dropped.reason: XE owns port publishing: the host port comes from the manifest's preferredHostPort or a free ephemeral port.

dropped.name: CHROMADB_BIND
dropped.reason: ChromaDB is not published to the host; Odysseus reaches it at chromadb:8000 on the instance network.

dropped.name: NTFY_BIND
dropped.reason: XE owns port publishing: ntfy is published to 127.0.0.1 by the engine.

dropped.name: APP_DATA_DIR
dropped.reason: XE owns storage placement: data lives under the instance directory as a declared storage entry.

dropped.name: APP_LOGS_DIR
dropped.reason: XE owns storage placement: logs live under the instance directory as a declared storage entry.

dropped.name: FASTEMBED_CACHE_PATH
dropped.reason: A host-path knob; the container default already lands inside the 'huggingface' storage mount.

dropped.name: GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID
dropped.reason: Google OAuth needs a redirect URI registered in advance, which a daemon-assigned loopback port cannot be. Deferred.

dropped.name: GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET
dropped.reason: Google OAuth needs a redirect URI registered in advance, which a daemon-assigned loopback port cannot be. Deferred.

dropped.name: GOOGLE_OAUTH_REDIRECT_URI
dropped.reason: Google OAuth needs a redirect URI registered in advance, which a daemon-assigned loopback port cannot be. Deferred.
